reason.en: This web address closely imitates a well-known regulator or broker domain (for example by swapping letters for numbers or changing the ending). Fraudsters clone trusted sites to steal logins and money.

action.en: Do not log in or pay here. Type the official address yourself or use the app from the official store — never a link sent to you.

label.en: Trusted brand name on an untrusted address

reason.en: This link uses a well-known brand name inside an address that does not actually belong to that brand. This is a common phishing trick.

action.en: Ignore the link. Reach the company only through its official website or app.
